title: Broad exception silently swallowed
description:
A broad `except` catches every error and neither logs nor re-raises it, hiding bugs and making failures invisible.
Related: S110: `try`-`except`-`pass` detected, consider logging the exception
recommendation: Catch the specific exceptions you expect; otherwise log with `logger.exception(...)` and re-raise. Also: Do not silently ignore exceptions; log them or handle the specific error. Also: Catch specific exceptions; a bare `except:` also swallows KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit.
test_recommendation: Force the guarded call to fail and assert the error is surfaced.
notes: merged with: E722: Do not use bare `except`
merged with: S110: `try`-`except`-`pass` detected, consider logging the exception

title: B006: Do not use mutable data structures for argument defaults
description: Do not use mutable data structures for argument defaults
recommendation: Use `None` as the default and create the mutable object inside the function; the default is shared across calls.
test_recommendation: Call the function twice without the argument and assert the results do not leak state between calls.

title: File opened without a context manager
